description:
You are a 3D artist creating a material showcase scene to demonstrate different material types. Starting from a nearly empty scene (only a camera and one light), build a complete showcase.

Requirements:
1. Add these 5 primitive mesh objects to the scene: a UV Sphere, a Cube, a Cylinder, a Cone, and a Torus
2. Create and assign a distinct material with a unique color to each of the 5 objects (e.g., red metal, blue glass, green plastic, gold, purple matte — or any 5 visually distinct materials)
3. Arrange the objects in a line or grid so none of them overlap each other
4. Add a large ground Plane underneath all objects
5. Ensure the scene has at least 2 light sources for proper illumination
6. Save the scene to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/showcase_scene.blend'
